The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 fafdf71eafc4700a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an integer GX ≥ 0, depending only on the embedded model X, with the following property. Given g1, . . . , gm ∈ L× whose classes in VL are independent, there is a quasi-prime (d − 1)-divisor w of L/l such that: (i) lw is algebraically closed and algebraic over a finite field of characteristic different from ℓ, and Lw is the function field of a smooth projective curve Cw/lw of genus at most GX; (ii) the gj are w-units and their residue classes are independent in VLw; (iii) for every j, #{x ∈ Cw(lw) : ordx(gj) ̸≡ 0 (mod ℓ)} = sX([gj]).
